entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Linda. How can I help you today?
Hi Linda. I'm calling about an order. I'd like to return my VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8776-5124.
Thank you, Alex. I see your account here. Yes, the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about a month ago. You'd like to return it?
That's right. I'd like to start a return.
No problem at all. I see you're well within the 90 days for a full refund. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
Oh, that's great. I wasn't sure what the policy was. That's very easy.
Of course. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you as we speak. I'll email it to the address on file. You just need to print it, put it on the box, and drop it at any post office.
Perfect. So I'll get the full refund once you receive it?

That's correct. And listen, I see you've been a VeloFit member for over five years. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for any future purchase. I hope you'll find another VeloFit product that works for you.
Wow, that's very generous. Thank you, Linda. I really appreciate that.
It's my pleasure, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again for making it so simple.
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
